Author: Subhash Chandra Sharma

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another Counsel for Applicant :- Ajay Vikram Yadav,Ashish Agrawal,Puneet Bhadauria

Counsel for Opposite Party :- Govt. Advocate Hon'ble Subhash Chandra Sharma,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicants as well as learned A.G.A. for the State.

The present application u/s 482 Cr.P.C. has been moved by the applicants with a prayer to quash the entire proceeding of Complaint Case No. 4041 of 2010 (Smt. Sanju @ Gudiya Vs. Pramod Kumar &
Others) under Section 498A, 323, 504 I.P.C. and 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Ikdil,
District, Etawah and further prayed to stay the further proceeding in the aforesaid case.

Others)

sentences.text:
It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicants that in this case applicants are mother-in-law,
sister-in-law and brother-in-law those were summoned for trial under Sections 498A, 323, 504 Pramod Kumar And Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 10 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/180970220/
1 I.P.C. and 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act.

entities.text: Pramod Kumar And Others vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is further submitted that the prayer for quashing of entire proceedings of the case on behalf of husband was refused by Co-ordinate Bench of this Court by order dated 06.03.2013 and against present applicants the proceedings were stayed.
It is further submitted that the marriage between the wife/complainant and the applicant no. 1 (Pramod Kumar)

was performed in the year 1996 and present complaint was lodged in the year 2010 with false allegations for making demand of dowry and causing harassment to the opposite party though there is nothing on record to show that such demand of dowry was made by the applicants and she was subjected to harassment by them.

It is also submitted that the applicants have no interest in making demand of dowry from the complainant and there is no any other specific allegation against them except general allegation for demand.
The statement of the complainant was also recorded under Section 200 Cr.P.C. in which she made similar statement against the applicants.

Likewise the statement of C.W. 1 Ashok Kumar and C.W. 2 Shankar Lal were recorded who also supported the version as made by the complainant in the complaint and also in her statement under Section 200 Cr.P.C. which is totally false and vague and also are not reliable even though the learned court concerned passed the summoning order against all the applicants including the husband.

It is further submitted that on the basis of vague and bald statements of the complainant and other witnesses present summoning order was passed by the learned court which cannot be said to be lawful but it amounts to misuse of process of the court, therefore, request to quash the entire proceedings of the case.
Learned counsel for the applicants has placed reliance on the judgment of the Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Geeta Mehrotra Vs. State of U.P. and others reported in 2012 (10) ADJ 464.

entities.text: Geeta Mehrotra Vs. State of U.P. and others reported in 2012 (10) ADJ 464
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned A.G.A. opposed the prayer as aforesaid and contended that in this case there is allegation relating to demand of dowry and harassment against all the applicants those are related to the husband of the complainant.
The allegation as made in the complaint has also been supported by her during the course of her examination under Section 200 Cr.P.C.
Other witnesses those are examined under Section 202 Cr.P.C. also supported the version of the complainant.

The learned court concerned passed the order dated 27.03.2012 by which applicant was summoned for trial under Sections 498A, 323, 504 I.P.C. and 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act after considering the allegation as made in the complaint, the statements of the complainant and other witnesses under Sections 200 and 202 Cr.P.C.
At this stage the veracity of the statements of the complainant and other witnesses cannot be examined but it is possible during the course of trial.
There is nothing on record to show that the statements made by the complainant and other witnesses are vague and not specific.

It is also contended that the applicants may have an option to move for discharge before the learned trial court at an appropriate stage but the order passed by the learned court cannot be said to be illegal and misuse of process of the court.

On considering the facts and circumstances of the case, submissions made by learned counsel for the applicants as well as learned A.G.A., perusal of record, the contents in the complaint, the statements made by complainant under Section 200 Cr.P.C., the statements of other witnesses as recorded under Section 202 Cr.P.C. and the order passed by the learned trial court for summoning dated 27.03.2012 at this stage it cannot be concluded that the version in the complaint and the statements of the complainant and other witnesses are not reliable or false since they are related to the facts of the case.

From the allegations, prima facie case appears to be made out, therefore, there Pramod Kumar And Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 10 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/180970220/
2 appears no ground to grant any indulgence in favour of the applicants at this stage.

entities.text: Pramod Kumar And Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 10 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
As a result,
prayer for quashing the entire proceedings of the case is hereby refused.
Further, applicants may have an option to move an application for discharge before the learned trial court which shall be heard and decided in accordance with law on the basis of material on record.
Accordingly, this application stands disposed of finally.
Order Date :- 10.9.2024
